title: Cold Spring Rising
author: Wren Coldharbour
blurb: Coral Oyelaran, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
